title: fix(ai-ollama): report finishReason length when num_predict cuts a stream

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@tanstack/ai-ollama': patch
+---
+
+Report `finishReason: "length"` on `RUN_FINISHED` when an Ollama stream ends with `done_reason: "length"`. This includes a reply cut by `num_predict`, and a tool call cut the same way. A normal stop stays `"stop"`. A finished tool call stays `"tool_calls"`.

+import { createServer } from 'node:http'
+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { chat } from '@tanstack/ai'
+import { createOllamaChat } from '@tanstack/ai-ollama'
+
+/**
+ * Streams one Ollama chat that stops at the `num_predict` limit
+ * (`done_reason: 'length'`). aimock always answers Ollama with
+ * `done_reason: 'stop'`, so this route serves the NDJSON stream itself from a
+ * throwaway local server. Returns the `finishReason` of the
+ * `RUN_FINISHED` chunk.
+ */
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/api/ollama-length-truncation')({
+  server: {
+    handlers: {
+      POST: async () => {
+        const stub = createServer((req, res) => {
+          req.resume()
+          res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/x-ndjson' })
+          const base = {
+            model: 'mistral',
+            created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
+          }
+          res.write(
+            JSON.stringify({
+              ...base,
+              message: { role: 'assistant', content: 'Hello there, my' },
+              done: false,
+            }) + '\n',
+          )
+          res.end(
+            JSON.stringify({
+              ...base,
+              message: { role: 'assistant', content: '' },
+              done: true,
+              done_reason: 'length',
+              prompt_eval_count: 13,
+              eval_count: 3,
+            }) + '\n',
+          )
+        })
+        await new Promise<void>((resolve) =>
+          stub.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve()),
+        )
+        const { port } = stub.address() as { port: number }
+
+        let runError: Record<string, unknown> | undefined
+        let finishReason: string | null | undefined
+        try {
+          const adapter = createOllamaChat('mistral', {
+            baseURL: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
+          })
+          for await (const chunk of chat({
+            threadId: 'ollama-length-truncation',
+            adapter,
+            messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'say hello in five words' }],
+          })) {
+            if (chunk.type === 'RUN_ERROR') runError = { code: chunk.code }
+            if (chunk.type === 'RUN_FINISHED') {
+              finishReason = chunk.metadata?.tanstack?.finishReason
+            }
+          }
+        } catch (error) {
+          return Response.json({
+            ok: false,
+            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+          })
+        } finally {
+          stub.close()
+        }
+
+        return Response.json({ ok: true, runError, finishReason })
+      },
+    },
+  },
+})

+import { test, expect } from './fixtures'
+
+/**
+ * An Ollama stream that stops at the `num_predict` limit
+ * (`done_reason: 'length'`) must end in `RUN_FINISHED` with
+ * `finishReason: 'length'`, not `'stop'`, so callers can tell the answer is
+ * incomplete.
+ */
+test.describe('ollama — num_predict truncation', () => {
+  test('RUN_FINISHED carries finishReason length', async ({ request }) => {
+    const res = await request.post('/api/ollama-length-truncation')
+    expect(res.ok()).toBe(true)
+
+    const { ok, runError, finishReason, error } = (await res.json()) as {
+      ok: boolean
+      error?: string
+      runError?: { code?: string }
+      finishReason?: string
+    }
+
+    expect(error ?? null).toBeNull()
+    expect(ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(runError).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(finishReason).toBe('length')
+  })
+})
